notes: 7.9.95 is the merge-safe NexoWatt EOS Admin release for npm dist-tag latest.
The flat update ZIP can be extracted directly over an existing repository folder.
All version-bearing release files are synchronized automatically before validation and npm publishing.
The 7.9.94 login, roles, password bootstrap, port 8081 and disabled EOS Assist remain functionally unchanged.
changes: Adds deterministic synchronization for package, io-package, lockfiles, frontend version, build info and repository entry.
Adds guarded Windows merge verification scripts without deleting .git or node_modules.
Adds a regression test proving that a stale 7.9.92 io-package is repaired before publication.
Adds a flat merge ZIP intended for direct extraction into the existing working folder.
Cleans the npm files manifest and rejects missing distribution entries before publication.
Aligns account-management and modern-UI self-tests with the documented stable initial-password and disabled-assistant contracts.
Synchronizes package-lock root scripts and release policy with package.json and validates lock metadata drift.
Builds a genuinely flat merge ZIP with repository files at archive root.
Keeps source-only validation helpers out of the installed npm runtime while retaining the supported update-repair helper.
